# `tfctl create`

The `tfctl create` command creates a new resource via the API.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl create RESOURCE [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl create` command creates a new resource via the API using a simplified interface. This is a convenience command that provides an easier way to create resources compared to using `tfctl api` directly.

Provide attributes using `-a key=value` (repeatable) or a raw request body with `-i`. Use `-i -` to read the request body from stdin.

Note: `-a` only sets `data.attributes`. Resources that require a relationships block (e.g., variable sets, policy sets) must use `-i` with a full JSON:API request body.

## Arguments

- `RESOURCE` - (Required) Resource type to create (For example, `workspace`, `project`).

## Available options

The `tfctl create` command supports the following options.

| Option | Description | Default | Required |
|--------|-------------|---------|----------|
| `-a, --attribute=KEY=VALUE` | Attribute for the JSON:API request body. Can be repeated for multiple attributes. Cannot be used with `--input`. Automatically constructs a JSON:API envelope with the specified attributes. | None | No |
| `-i, --input=BODY` | Raw JSON request body (or `-` to read from stdin). Cannot be used with `--attribute`. | None | No |
| `-o, --organization=NAME` | Organization name. | Auto-resolved from profile or Terraform cloud config | No |

### Global flags

Refer to [Global flags reference](/terraform/tfctl-cli/reference/cli#global-flags) for information about flags you can use with all commands.

## Examples

### Create a workspace using attributes

```shell-session
$ tfctl create workspace -a name=my-workspace
```

### Create a workspace from a JSON file

```shell-session
$ tfctl create workspace -i @workspace.json
```

### Create a project with inline JSON

```shell-session
$ tfctl create project -i '{"data":{"type":"projects","attributes":{"name":"my-project"}}}'
```

### Create a workspace in a specific organization

```shell-session
$ tfctl create workspace -a name=my-workspace -o my-org
```
